description: This file defines the IEventHandler interface within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. The interface declares four pure virtual methods for handling container events, namely start, stop, failure, and state change, each accepting a JsonObject reference as a parameter. It appears to be a contract for event handling related to container lifecycle management.

classes.name: IEventHandler
classes.description: Interface defining callback methods for container lifecycle events.

methods.name: onContainerStarted
methods.description: Called when a container has started.

methods.description: Called when a container has stopped.

methods.name: onContainerFailed
methods.description: Called when a container has failed.
